triggers.prompt: My GitHub stars are a mess. Can you sort them into lists that make sense?
triggers.expected: Fires, runs the dependency and sign-in check, exports the account, and proposes lists before writing anything.

triggers.prompt: The lists in my GitHub Starred dropdown have inconsistent names and one is misspelled. Clean up the names and put every repo in the right list.
triggers.expected: Fires; renaming lists and reassigning every starred repository is what it does.

triggers.prompt: I starred a bunch of repos this week that aren't in any of my GitHub lists yet. File them.
triggers.expected: Fires and assigns only the unlisted stars to existing lists, leaving the rest alone.

triggers.prompt: I don't like how my GitHub star lists were reorganized yesterday. Put them back the way they were.
triggers.expected: Fires and restores from the backup apply wrote, after showing the diff.

non_triggers.prompt: Unstar every repository I starred before 2020.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; it never stars or unstars repositories.

non_triggers.prompt: Archive the repositories under my GitHub account that I haven't pushed to in two years.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; it organizes stars, not repositories the user owns.

non_triggers.prompt: Set up a GitHub Projects board with columns for todo, doing and done.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; GitHub Projects are a different feature.

behaviors.prompt: Organize my GitHub stars. This is a brand-new laptop and gh is not installed.
expectations: Runs sh scripts/run.sh doctor first and reports what it found.
Asks before running doctor --install, and says the tools land in a user directory without sudo.
Has the user sign in through gh auth login --web rather than asking for a password or token in chat.

behaviors.prompt: Reorganize my GitHub star lists however you think is best, you can create and delete lists.
expectations: Shows the diff, including lists to delete and how many repositories move, before running apply --yes.
Waits for an explicit yes to that diff.
Reports the backup path apply printed and the verification result.

behaviors.prompt: Organiza mis repositorios con estrella de GitHub en listas, por favor.
expectations: Replies to the user in Spanish.
Writes every list name and description in the plan in English.
Runs check on the plan before showing the diff.
